title: Empirical integration of a formal network verifier as an oracle inside an LLM Generate–Verify–Repair loop for intent→configuration pipelines
research_question: Does embedding a formal-network verifier as an oracle inside a paired Generate–Verify–Repair (GVR) loop increase detection/rejection of unsafe or incorrect LLM-generated network configurations and improve end-to-end repair success versus a generate-only baseline?
confirmatory_hypotheses: Embedding a formal verifier as an oracle in a GVR loop increases the proportion of unsafe or incorrect generated configurations that are detected and rejected relative to a generate-only baseline (paired estimand).

When the verifier rejects a candidate, a bounded automated LLM-guided repair loop (bounded attempts per the registered adapter) will produce a verifier-accepted configuration within the preregistered repair budget more often than single-shot generation.
exploratory_questions: By how much do false-accept and false-reject rates (verifier vs. emulator ground truth) vary across vendor-style syntaxes and topology templates?
Does a conservative vs permissive verifier rule-set materially change measured repair success and false-accept rates?
benchmark_scope: SyntheticNetOpsIntentConfig_v1 (public synthetic intent→configuration suite produced and published with this study)
Emulator environment: Kathará/Mininet emulation images (Docker-based) for dynamic semantic ground-truth
primary_estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline (paired difference in proportion of unsafe configs detected/rejected by the verifier in GVR arm minus baseline generate-only detection)
secondary_estimands: repair_success_probability_conditional_on_initial_reject (proportion of rejected tasks where bounded repair produced verifier-accepted config)
verifier_false_accept_rate (verifier accepted but emulator reports violation)
verifier_false_reject_rate (verifier rejected but emulator reports safe)
sampling_plan: Paired within-task design. N = 270 distinct intent→configuration tasks constructed as 3 vendor-style syntaxes × 3 topology templates = 9 clusters × 30 tasks per cluster = 270 tasks. For each task both arms executed (A) generate-only baseline: single generation attempt; (B) guarded (GVR) via adapter: generate, verifier check, and if rejected invoke bounded repair loop per adapter (maximum 1 repair call per task). Random seeds and deterministic prompt templates are fixed and recorded. Validation subset: 20% stratified sample (6 tasks per cluster × 9 clusters = 54 tasks) reserved for verifier-vs-emulator coverage validation (device-executed via emulator) and used to compute verifier false-accept/false-reject rates.
power_and_precision_plan: Primary estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline. Target effect: absolute difference of 0.10 (10 percentage points) in detection/rejection proportion between GVR and baseline. Calculation method: approximate paired binary power reasoning (McNemar-style normal approximation) with two-sided alpha=0.05, power=0.80. With N=270 paired observations the MDE ≈ 0.10 under conservative assumptions; exact tests and CIs will be computed by the registered analysis executor. Sensitivity analyses: vary baseline p0 between 0.30 and 0.70 and alternate failed-call treatments.
exclusion_rules: Exclude tasks only when infrastructure/emulator failure prevents acquisition of emulator ground truth; all exclusions and counts will be reported.
Automatically exclude exact-duplicate tasks detected by deterministic SHA-256 hashing from the primary analysis (see contamination plan).
missingness_plan: Model/API call failures: deterministic retry policy up to 2 retries per failed call with exponential backoff; retries logged. If retries exhaust, treat the pair according to the registered analysis primary option 'complete_pair_primary' (pair remains but handled by analysis executor). Sensitivity analysis will treat unresolved generation/repair failures as 'zero' successes ('complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity'). No manual human intervention; any task with emulator infrastructure failure recorded and excluded only if ground-truth cannot be obtained.
analysis_plan: Primary analysis executed by registered executor 'paired_binary_analysis_v1' computing estimand 'paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline' (primary_estimand_id). Test: paired-proportion comparison (McNemar / paired binary analysis) two-sided alpha=0.05 with 95% CIs. Report repair-success probability conditional on initial rejection and compute number-needed-to-repair. Report verifier false-accept and false-reject rates against emulator ground truth from the 54-task validation set and for all emulator-checked tasks. Primary failed-call treatment: 'complete_pair_primary'; sensitivity: 'complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity'. Subgroup analyses by vendor-style and topology (Bonferroni-corrected per multiplicity_plan). All analysis code, raw outputs, and exact test implementations are logged and versioned.
multiplicity_plan: Primary outcome is a single preregistered paired comparison. Nine preregistered subgroup comparisons (3 vendors × 3 topologies) will use Bonferroni correction: adjusted alpha = 0.05/9 = 0.0056. All secondary/exploratory analyses flagged as exploratory and interpreted with caution.
contamination_plan: Benchmarks: SyntheticNetOpsIntentConfig_v1. Risks: pre-lock development artifacts reuse, duplicate/near-duplicate tasks leaking between validation/confirmatory sets, retrieval-store contamination. Detection: deterministic SHA-256 hashing of all prompts/intents/retrieved documents per invocation; automated exact and fuzzy duplicate detection (token-level Jaccard similarity threshold 0.9); deterministic snapshotting and freezing of the RAG retrieval index at experiment start. Item treatment: exact duplicates excluded automatically from primary analysis; near-duplicates exceeding threshold flagged and moved to diagnostic set; sensitivity analyses reported with/without flagged items. Residual uncertainty: undetected semantic near-duplicates below fuzzy threshold and potential overlap with model training data.
stopping_rule: No interim statistical stopping rules. Stop when all 270 paired task executions complete successfully or when the 7-day wall-clock execution limit is reached. Per-call retries limited to 2 attempts; no early stopping based on interim outcomes is permitted.
planned_outputs: Verified preregistration JSON and execution manifest
Dockerized emulator images and transformation unit tests
Execution logs and hashed raw transcripts for all model calls
Analysis code and outputs for paired_binary_analysis_v1
IEEE-format LaTeX manuscript (≤5 pages) with Disclosure Statement
